messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate + latency spike on /v1/generate (kv-cache growth) -- severity: P1. Pager details: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/2150045678
Sam (oncall): I see the alert, joining. Any customer impact reports yet?
Nina: UI dashboards show tail latency > 2s and token cost spiking on qwen-mqa models in us-west-2. Error rate up ~6% for the last 6m.
Sam (oncall): Rolling logs now. Sam: running `kubectl logs -f inference-qwen-mqa-*-pod | grep kv_cache` to confirm eviction messages.
Arya: I'm seeing continuous_batch queue size ramping, prefix KV hit drops to 12% then evictions spike. Likely batching window miscalculation after yesterday's canary.
Jordan: Which canary? We rolled a tiny Llama-quant patch at 03:10 that touched batch_policy. Could that have cross-routed policy?
Nina: Canary was for llama-13b-quant-rev2. But routing matrix update accidentally added a fallback route: `if model not available -> qwen-mqa-v2` with adopt_batch_policy: true. That might have applied incompatible batching for MQA.
Sam (oncall): Repro: queries with short prefixes get aggregated into huge continuous batches. KV cache keeps growing due to long-lived prefetched keys. CPU on the batcher pod shoots to 95%.
Arya: Immediate mitigation: disable continuous_batching for qwen-mqa in-prod. Command in console: `PATCH /config/models/qwen-mqa/policy {"continuous_batching": false}`.
Sam (oncall): Applying now. Patch applied.
DeployBot: Config change deployed to us-west-2: models/qwen-mqa/policy continuous_batching=false (rev 4823).
Nina: Monitoring... KV cache growth stopped increasing within 30s, tail latency trending down. Error rate still slightly elevated, likely from in-flight batches failing.
Jordan: Can we also push a temporary route fallback to an older qwen-mqa variant that uses GQA-safe batching? `route: qwen-mqa-v1 -> prefer gqa-policy`
Arya: I'll create a canary fallback with traffic=10% to start. Creating route now.
Sam (oncall): Creating a transient rate limit to throttled capacity to reduce cost while we stabilize: `quota:set --model qwen-mqa --burst 200`
DeployBot: Route created: qwen-mqa -> qwen-mqa-v1 (10% canary). Quota updated.
Nina: KPIs: 2m after fixes - tail latency down to 380ms, errors down to 0.9%. Token cost still above baseline but trending.
CS-Eng: Heads-up from CS: two customers opened tickets reporting slow responses and rate-limiting errors on their endpoints. They're asking for impact window and any rollback.
Sam (oncall): Note customer-facing rollback not yet required; we've stabilized. I'll prepare a short incident notification and estimated MTTI.
Arya: Root cause hypothesis: routing matrix change allowed policy inheritance to mutate active batching config for models with MQA optimizations. The mixing of GQA/MQA batching semantics caused inefficient KV lifetime retention and oversized continuous batches.
Jordan: Short-term fix: revert routing matrix merge that introduced `adopt_batch_policy` inheritance and add explicit model-level override to prevent future bleed-through. I'll open a PR now.
Sam (oncall): PR 9987 created to revert inherit flag + add test. @Jordan paste link.
Jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/9987 -- contains unit test for batch_policy isolation. Requesting urgent review.
Nina: We'll also add an alert for rapid KV cache size growth per model shard (>20%/min) so we catch this before customer impact.
Sam (oncall): On-call handoff: I'll keep monitoring for 15 more minutes then hand off to Jordan for postmortem work. Handing off at 2150046050.
DeployBot: Incident annotation: config-change rollback + canary fallback applied.
Sam (oncall): Final status: mitigated, customer impact limited but real for two tenants (high latency, transient errors). Next steps: postmortem, retro on routing matrix deploy process, and customer outreach draft by CS.
CS-Eng: We'll prepare an initial customer note estimating 12:03-12:18 UTC window, affected endpoints: /v1/generate for qwen-mqa models in us-west-2, and list mitigations.
Arya: Adding postmortem ticket: /ops/incidents/2150045678/postmortem and linking PR and logs.
Jordan: I'll follow up with a hotfix to the config inheritance tests and add a canary gating step for routing matrix changes.
Sam (oncall): Thanks team. I'll finalize the incident summary and mark the page P1-> mitigated. Sam: handing off to Jordan now.
Jordan: Taking over for postmortem and action items.
IncidentBot: Incident 2150045678 status updated to 'mitigated' by Sam at 2150046120.
